name: Tachibana Sylphinford
original_name: 橘・シルフィンフォード
source: Umaru's classmate who is equally popular and comes from a wealthy family. She is very openly competitive and considers Umaru a rival in academics and sports. She becomes friends with Umaru's video game persona UMR with hopes of beating Umaru at school. Sheäs also quick to feel embarassed when she realises that people are watching her show off, especially if her brother Alex is present.
translation: Umaru's classmate who is equally popular and comes from a wealthy family. She is very openly competitive and considers Umaru a rival in academics and sports. She becomes friends with Umaru's video game persona UMR with hopes of beating Umaru at school. Sheäs also quick to feel embarassed when she realises that people are watching her show off, especially if her brother Alex is present.
